        Blessing Computers Limited is one of the prominent, futuristic and forefront leaders in the world of Sales and Marketing of Information Technology products and Allied Services, inclusive of providing Support to her teeming Clientele. Incorporated under the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) since 2003, Blessing Computers has consistently been household name in the sales and distribution of computer systems, inclusive of laptops, desktops, printers, network servers, as well as myriad of accessories required in the dispense of prime technology experience, both for personal usage and corporate entities.

Job Location: Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

	Provide accurate information about the company’s products and services.

	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

	Must be courteous, patient, and customer-oriented.
	Previous customer service experience is an added advantage.
